scripts.dev: concurrently --names 'WORKER,GATEWAY,FRONTEND' --prefix-colors 'green,blue,yellow' 'bun run worker' 'bun run gateway' 'bun run frontend'
scripts.lint: bun run lint:worker && bun run lint:gateway && bun run lint:frontend
scripts.build:gateway: cd gateway && bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --outdir dist
